:::{#exm-reducible-risk}
#### Reducible risk in the best-predictor exercise

In @exr-best-predictor,
the constant [prediction function](#def-prediction-function) $\predfn_1$, with $\predfn_1\paren{\Predvar} = 3$, has [reducible risk](#def-reducible-risk) $5 - 1 = 4$,
and the prediction function $\predfn_2$, with $\predfn_2\paren{\Predvar} = 4\Predvar$, has reducible risk $2 - 1 = 1$.

:::
